text: In WDM broadcast-and-weight, reading a microring's drop and through ports with a balanced photodetector pair yields a signed effective weight in the range [-1, +1], enabling both excitation and inhibition.
explanation: True. The book gives the effective weight w_i proportional to eta_drop minus eta_through, in [-1, +1], produced by balanced detection of the drop and through ports. That difference measurement is exactly what makes signed (excitatory AND inhibitory) weights possible.
